entities.name: Asuga
entities.description: Orochi ninja of the Order of Jukai bonded to a vine-binding kami.

entities.name: Rei
entities.description: Asari human samurai from the Towashi Undercity who uses they/them pronouns.

entities.name: Touma
entities.description: Imperial human samurai from a rich family, protagonist of Kamigawa: A Visual Novel.

entities.name: Kenta
entities.description: Okiba Reckoner nezumi ninja, childhood friend of Rei.

entities.name: Doku
entities.description: Orochi fighter, champion of the Towashi Undercity pits and former Yoruma Reckoner.

entities.name: Itachi
entities.description: Gray nezumi who owns a noodle bar in the Towashi Undercity and trades for information.

entities.name: Junichiro
entities.description: Human samurai covered in tattoos binding kami; a former Imperial who joined the Hyozan Reckoners.

entities.name: Yume
entities.description: Human druid of the Living Historians who collects stories from other planes.

entities.name: Saiba Futurists
entities.description: Faction that pulled a kami from a merge planning to weaponize it.

entities.name: Order of Jukai
entities.description: Order of ninja to which Asuga belongs.

entities.name: Living Historians
entities.description: Group of which Yume is a member.

entities.name: Towashi Undercity
entities.description: Kamigawan undercity where Rei grew up.

events.summary: The Saiba Futurists pull a kami from a merge, planning to weaponize it; Rei and Touma travel with Asuga to recover it.
events.quote: When Saiba Futurists pulled a kami from a merge, planning to weaponize it, they traveled with Asuga and Touma to recover it.

events.summary: Asuga's cell is killed after the Saiba Futurists give them false information as a distraction.
events.quote: Her cell was killed in a fight after the Saiba Futurists gave them false information as a distraction to capture a kami.

relations.quote: He was a childhood friend of Rei.
Asuga of the Order of Hanami is an orochi ninja in the Order of Jukai .
He is a former Imperial who joined the Hyozan Reckoners .
Yume is a human druid member of the Living Historians .
